name: OSC Mission Authorization Pilot Program
status: Expressions of interest from space operators to participate in program's pilot phase due 10/5/2026
effect: Seeks to implement a streamlined, unified, whole-of-government mission authorization framework for novel in-space activities
alignment_notes: Aligns with Pillars 1 and 2: Addresses the report’s call to clarify regulatory responsibility for space activities, and creates a pathway for the active debris removal and on-orbit servicing the report urges
sponsors: Gabriel Swiney (Director of OSC's Policy, Advocacy, and International Division)
